- Two columns, roughly 55 lines each, small Gothic textualis (glossing/legal type script), heavy abbreviation.
- Column a: series of enlarged 2-line initials alternating red and blue at the left (S, D, A, B?, P, D?, P?, D) with paragraph-mark style openings; frequent red/blue paragraph marks (¶-type) and rubricated "Em." / "C." type marks inside lines (appear as "Em.g." style highlighted reference cues). Tentative interpretation: a densely abbreviated commentary-type prose text with lemmata introduced by coloured initials and frequent internal references; I will not guess further.
